    StartersDetention sweet and salty snack mixHoney popcorn baked crisp and tossed with a bag of salty snacksHow to make it80g popping corn1 tbsp vegetable oil2 tbsp honey20g butter170g ridged potato chips150g pretzels150g chocolate-coated peanuts200g sour lolliesPop the corn in the oil in a covered pot.Warm the honey with the butter and a pinch of salt and toss through the popcorn.Bake at 160°C, then cool.Toss with the chips, pretzels and chocolate peanuts in a big bowl and put the lollies in a small bowl alongside.Bravestone's mango salsa and chipsMango, red onion, chilli, coriander and lime salsa with corn chipsHow to make it2 mangoes1/2 red onion1 red chilli1 bunch coriander2 limes230g corn chipsDice the mangoes and the onion and chop the chilli and coriander.Mix with lime juice and salt.Rest so the juices come out, then serve with corn chips.Jungle bazaar chicken skewersThe bazaar in the gameHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thigh marinated in yoghurt, garlic, paprika and lemon, grilled on skewers until charred, with garlic yoghurt dip and warm flatbread.Cut 800g chicken thighs into chunks and marinate for 2 hours in 150g Greek yoghurt, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, lemon juice and salt.Thread onto 8 skewers and grill on high for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred.Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a grated garlic clove, lemon and mint.Warm 4 flatbreads on the grill.Grilled pineapple with chilli saltRuby's weakness is venom. milk until fragrant.Add the chicken, the remaining coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar.Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through.Cook the rice and
